name: zgeometry_vec3array_compute_bounds_xy
description: zGeometry_Vec3Array::ComputeBoundsXY computes minX, maxX, maxY, and minY over a point array.
known_limits: Binary Ninja still renders the initial Y seed awkwardly after the first-point stride advance; assembly confirms the first point's y initializes maxY/minY. tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zGeometry vector/model source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x46a9c0 validates seeding minX/maxX from the first point's x, seeding maxY/minY from the first point's y, then scanning remaining points and updating all four bounds.
The native vector leaf smoke verifies mixed positive and negative X/Y coordinates produce the expected XY bounds.
